# ankra_service_credential (Resource)

A managed-service credential (`ankra services credentials`): a named family of immutable secret values a service package's inputs are granted. The value is write-only (Terraform 1.11 or later): it goes to the platform's secret store and never reaches plan or state. Changing `value_wo_version` writes `value_wo` as the new active value in place. Writing a new value retires the previous one, revokes its grants and reissues them on the new value. The platform has no route that deletes a credential family, so destroy only stops managing it: the family and its active value stay. Needs `applications.write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_service_credential" "billing_database" {
  name             = "billing-db"
  value_wo         = var.billing_database_url
  value_wo_version = 1
}

variable "billing_database_url" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `name` (String) Family name: lower-case words joined by hyphens, at most 63 characters. Changing it creates another family.
- `value_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The secret value, as a write-only attribute.
- `value_wo_version` (Number) Version of `value_wo`. Changing it writes `value_wo` as the new active value. Right after an import the configured version is recorded without writing a value.

### Read-Only

- `active_value_id` (String) Identifier of the active value, which grants reference.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the credential family.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by credential family id. The value is never read back.
terraform import ankra_service_credential.billing_database 5d6e7f80-91a2-4b33-8c4d-5e6f7a8b9c0d
```
